notes: 'therefrom' is a rule 30 fusion of מִן plus its suffix, headed on the preposition with the competing head named.
The explicit subject אֵשׁ keeps its own unit, leaving 'shall come forth' discontinuous around it (rules 17, 25).
'the midst of the fire' writes two 'the's, so the rectum's article takes the one before its own word (rule 29); בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל has no article morpheme and takes a supplied one.
